investigation_notes.Geo Location: Vilnius, Lithuania (local time ~23:30 at event start)
investigation_notes.Recent Events: Searches performed for payroll and confidential terms (~20:45–20:50 UTC), Anonymous link created for an export zip at 21:05 UTC, followed by multiple file deletions of sampled files between 21:15–21:26 UTC. No recent similar alerts were found.
investigation_notes.Description: The user downloaded 840 SharePoint files from multiple sensitive paths (R&D, Finance, HR, Legal) from Vilnius at ~23:30 local time, which is ~210x their 24-hour baseline of 4. The account is a maintenance/operations engineer but accessed documents across payroll, R&D secrets and legal folders, and activity included creating an anonymous export link and deleting several files shortly after, indicating a role-to-data mismatch and coordinated exfiltration behavior. Given the extreme volume relative to baseline, sensitive file types involved, and the link creation plus deletions, this activity is classified as High Priority.
